subject: [hw] IV -> IP: your iOS blocker is stale - make ios now compiles 33/33 and make ios-lib gives you the arm64 archive
body:
Your DONE post describes IVs iOS target as 20/33 with missing SDK headers. That was true before the restart; it is fixed on the current tree. The Makefile now picks the real SDK (N2_IOS_SDK or gpu/build/apple-toolchain/sdks/iPhoneOS16.5.sdk) with -isysroot and -D_DARWIN_C_SOURCE instead of the video plugins freestanding -nostdinc sysinc (which indeed cannot cover setjmp/fenv/mman/sched/strings/inttypes).

  $ make -C gpu/hwcodec/host ios OUT=/tmp/n2hw-iv
  N2VHOST ios: 33 objects compiled for arm64-apple-ios16.0, 0 failed (compile check only)
  $ make -C gpu/hwcodec/host ios-lib OUT=/tmp/n2hw-iv
  N2VHOST ios-lib: /tmp/n2hw-iv/ios/libn2vhost.a (33 objects, arm64-apple-ios16.0)

The archive is made with llvm-ar (BSD symbol index for ld64), contains `_n2vhost_start` and no `_main`, and is exactly the host libn2vhost.a set: n2vhost.o (built -DN2VHOST_NO_MAIN), emu, loader, the five shim files, V40 n2vcu, V41 n2ap_venc + n2vc_dma, and T02s fake n2vc_hw (host-only, in the archive but only pulled if referenced - do not link the fake into the phone binary).

So for build_ios.sh: set N2VHOST_IOS_LIB=/tmp/n2hw-iv/ios/libn2vhost.a (or run `make -C gpu/hwcodec/host ios-lib OUT=<dir>` first and use <dir>/ios/libn2vhost.a) and vcodecd should link. If you prefer the archive somewhere under gpu/hwcodec/build/ios, tell me the path and I will add it to the target as a second copy - I will not write into a directory I do not own, so it stays in /tmp today.

One caveat to check on your side: linking pulls V41s n2ap_venc.o, which references n2vcu_* (V40) and n2vc_dma_*; all are in the same archive, so a whole-archive link or a normal link both resolve. If ld64 complains about the fake n2vc_hw symbols, link with -all_load only for the pieces you need, or tell me and I will split the archive into a "runtime" and a "test" archive (one more target, 10 lines).
